title: Business Rule
description: Format for business rules stored in memory/business-rules/RULE-{MODULE}-{NNN}.md

modulo.description: Business module this rule belongs to

impacto.description: Files and functions affected by this rule (used by auditor for grep verification)

confidence.description: Confidence score. Rules with confidence < 0.8 are treated as unverified.

reemplazada_por.description: ID of the rule that replaces this one, if estado=reemplazada

fecha_creacion.description: ISO 8601 date when the rule was created

motivo_cambio.description: Reason for the last change, if any

autorizado_por.description: Who authorized this rule (typically 'usuario' or a team name)
